Documentar com excelência em prontuário e sistemas de coordenação do cuidado, mantendo pendências, acordos e tarefas sempre em dia.  Atuar com foco em qualidade e eficiência do cuidado (APS na prática), contribuindo para redução de sinistralidade por prevenção, coordenação e direcionamento adequado.    Principais requisitos:    Formação e vivência em APS / Saúde Coletiva / Programas de Saúde / Coordenação do Cuidado.  Vivência em atendimento digital/teleatendimento e navegação de paciente.  Capacidade de estratificação de risco, triagem e encaminhamento conforme protocolos.    Trilha de navegação em Gestantes e Puericultura: Cuidado materno-infantil exige precisão. Aqui, sua expertise faz a diferença.  Se você acredita em cuidado contínuo, prevenção e coordenação inteligente, essa trilha é para você. Aqui, você acompanha gestantes já captadas e garante uma jornada completa e segura — do pré-natal ao puerpério, com orientação clínica, engajamento por mensageria e teleatendimento, fechamento de gaps assistenciais e atuação rápida quando surgem sinais de risco, sempre com excelência de experiência. Estratificar risco (clínico e comportamental) e definir a jornada de cuidado (baixo/alto risco), com prioridades, cadência e próximos passos claros.  Realizar atendimentos por teleatendimento e vídeo síncrono, escolhendo o formato mais conveniente para maximizar adesão e continuidade. Para que a estratégia seja assertiva, a pessoa CX Designer fará parte de uma equipe ágil composta por Desenvolvedores, Líderes Técnicos, Analistas de QA, Analistas Funcionais, Product Owners (PO) e Scrum Masters. Garantir a Rastreabilidade da Jornada: O desafio central é desenhar e documentar detalhadamente o tagueamento (instrumentação de dados) em cada ponto de interação da jornada (WhatsApp/Chatbot), garantindo que todos os eventos e gargalos do cliente sejam corretamente identificados e mensurados para análise de dados e Business Intelligence. Otimização Contínua do Fluxo: Identificar e reprojetar os pontos de fricção (pain points), drop-offs e repetição de ciclos na jornada, transformando interações complexas em experiências fluidas e de baixo esforço. Equilibrar Automação e Experiência Humana: Desenhar flows que maximizem a resolução de problemas por automação, mas que garantam uma transição suave e eficiente para o atendimento humano quando necessário, mantendo a voz e a personalidade da marca. Tradução de Requisitos de Negócio em UX Funcional: Converter objetivos de negócio complexos em arquiteturas conversacionais e fluxos de usuário simples e compreensíveis. Requisitos Empatia e Customer Centricity: Capacidade genuína de se colocar no lugar do usuário para identificar pontos de dor e oportunidades de melhoria. Comunicação e Relacionamento Interpessoal: Clareza para articular insights, defender propostas de design e interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. Negociação e Persuasão: Habilidade para influenciar o roadmap do produto e negociar soluções de design que equilibrem a experiência do cliente com os objetivos de negócio e as restrições técnicas. Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes dinâmicos e lidar com feedbacks e iterações rápidas, mantendo o foco na melhoria contínua. Organização e Gestão de Fluxo: Proficiência em documentar, organizar e gerenciar a complexidade de fluxos de conversação e jornadas do usuário. Liderança e Proatividade: Iniciativa para conduzir pesquisas, propor soluções e atuar como líder de pensamento em UX dentro da equipe.  Requisitos técnicos (hard skills) Experiência Comprovada em Design Conversacional (Conversational UX/CUX): Sólida experiência no design de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de flows (fluxos), scripts e personas conversacionais. Mapeamento de Jornada e Fluxos: Domínio em ferramentas e metodologias para mapear jornadas do usuário, blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade. Tagueamento e Instrumentação de Dados (Analytics): Experiência em definir a estratégia e os requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de UX e negócio (ex: Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso, CSAT conversacional). Prototipação e Testes: Proficiência em ferramentas de prototipação (Figma, Miro ou similar) e experiência na condução de testes de usabilidade, A/B testing e análise heurística em canais conversacionais. Conhecimento de Plataformas de Chatbot/WhatsApp: Familiaridade com as limitações e capacidades de plataformas populares de construção de chatbots e APIs de WhatsApp Business. UX Research: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para fundamentar decisões de design (entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação, pesquisa de satisfação). Conceitos Ágeis: Experiência de trabalho em squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração estreita com Product Owners (PO) e engenheiros.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Talent Acquisition | Strategic HR | Diversity & Inclusion  Do you want to work on the largest healthcare platform in the WORLD ?  We are Doctoralia, a Docplanner Group company, present in 13 countries, responsible for serving more than 55 million patients and processing more than 15 million appointments per month!  We currently have more than 2 million healthcare professionals in our database, totaling approximately 10 million patient evaluations to date.  Our mission is to “help people live longer, healthier lives.”  Through a diverse range of services, we serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.  Here at DOC, we value and celebrate diversity in all its forms. We are committed to attracting diverse talent regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, age or physical condition. We are committed to building an inclusive and welcoming team where each individual can excel and contribute their best.  Job Description  We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-driven Revenue Operations Manager to lead our revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment (B2C2B). This role will oversee the entire revenue lifecycle across Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and Customer Success Ops, ensuring alignment, efficiency, and growth across each stage of the customer journey.  As part of Doctoralia, the leading digital healthcare platform in Brazil and part of the Docplanner Group, you will play a key role in unlocking scalable growth by enabling data-driven decisions, optimizing operational processes, and ensuring seamless execution across go-to-market functions.  Responsibilities   Own the end-to-end revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment;  Partner with Marketing, Sales, and CS leadership to design, execute, and optimize lead-to-revenue processes;  Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and forecasting tools to track funnel performance, conversion rates, and growth drivers;  Lead systems and tooling enhancements (CRM, marketing automation, customer platforms) to enable scalability and visibility;  Identify operational bottlenecks and lead cross-functional initiatives to solve them;  Create lead scoring, routing, and segmentation logic to improve acquisition efficiency;  Design playbooks and workflows to drive adoption and retention across the funnel;  Ensure governance, data hygiene, and operational rigor across revenue platforms;    Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or similar (MBA is a plus);  Solid experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Growth Operations roles;  Experience managing cross-functional revenue funnels (Marketing → Sales → CS);  Proficiency in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive), BI tools (Looker, Tableau), and Excel/Google Sheets;  Strong analytical and modeling skills (SQL or data querying is a plus);  Fluency in Portuguese; business English required.    Key Competencies   Analytical Thinking: Able to interpret data to inform strategy and drive decisions;  Revenue Orientation: Understands the full funnel impact of operations on growth;  Process Optimization: Passion for reducing inefficiencies and building scalable systems;  Collaboration: Skilled at aligning cross-functional stakeholders and driving action;  Ownership Mentality: Bias toward execution and continuous improvement.    Our benefits   Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;  We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);  Food/Market Voucher with iFood card;  Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;  Pet Plan;  StarBem, for mental health and well-being;  iFeel app, for emotional comfort;  Gympass for you and up to 3 people;  Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;  Stock Options – eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period);  Birthday Day Off;  Daycare Assistance;  Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;  Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;  Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms.      #J-18808-Ljbffr

Join to apply for the Remote Senior Sales Representative  role at THE/STUDIO   Global Talent Acquisition Partner | Startup Hiring  Remote – Open to candidates from anywhere in the world    Latin America preferred due to timezone alignment    Working hours: US Pacific Time    Sales experience required, with strong English communication skills  About Us  At THE/STUDIO, our vision is to empower individuals, regardless of their expertise, to unleash their creativity and bring their unique ideas to life through the production of custom products. We are committed to delivering top-quality customized products that not only exceed expectations but also provide a seamless and awe‑inspiring experience via our exceptional team and AI‑integrated systems. By shouldering the manufacturing burdens, we liberate our customers to focus on their true passions, driving them towards remarkable success and fulfillment. Together, we turn dreams into tangible realities and shape a world where creativity knows no bounds.  Our headquarters are in Los Angeles, California, but we are a truly global company with team‑members across the U.S., Europe, South America, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. We have gone to a fully remote  working platform so that we can attract the world’s best talent.  All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, as long as you have all your tools and a fast, stable internet connection!  We know that some applicants will not meet all the requirements, so we encourage you to apply anyway so we can determine if something else might be a good fit!  The Role  At THE/STUDIO, we help creators and brands bring their product ideas to life: from custom hats to packaging. Our Creative Specialists are trusted advisors to our customers: they don’t just close deals, they build long-term partnerships that fuel repeat business.  We’re looking for experienced sales professionals with a strong consultative sales foundation who can confidently manage inbound opportunities, uncover deeper customer needs, and nurture accounts over time. This role is ideal for someone who already knows how to sell, structure their day, and run a pipeline; and is excited to apply those skills in a fast‑paced, remote‑first startup environment.  As a Creative Specialist, you’ll own the full inbound sales cycle while developing repeat customers by helping them grow their own businesses through THE/STUDIO’s manufacturing solutions.  What You’ll Do   Consult with inbound leads to deeply understand customer goals, timelines, and long‑term needs.  Apply a consultative sales approach to guide customers through design, pricing, and production decisions.  Own and manage customer accounts with a focus on nurturing repeat business and long‑term value.  Maintain a structured, self‑driven sales workflow with clear follow‑up cadences and prioritization.  Manage your pipeline in HubSpot with speed, accuracy, and strong CRM hygiene.  Confidently handle objections and position THE/STUDIO as the trusted alternative to “cheap but risky” sourcing options.  Collaborate closely with the Sales Team Lead, Production, and Design teams to ensure smooth handoffs and accurate execution.  Oversee order tracking, delivery coordination, and post‑sale follow‑ups to strengthen customer relationships.  Consistently meet and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.  Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, tools, and workflows as we scale.    What Success Looks Like  Within Your First Month    Ramp quickly and gain a strong understanding of THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and product offering.  Become proficient with inbound email sequencing, fast sales cadences, and CRM workflows.  Begin laying the groundwork for future repeat business through thoughtful follow‑ups and account notes.    Within 3 Months    Master how to identify, build, and nurture repeat customers with well‑defined follow‑up cadences.  Run a fully self‑driven, structured day‑to‑day sales workflow.  Proactively advise customers on how they can grow their own businesses using THE/STUDIO.  Demonstrate excellent CRM hygiene and clear account ownership.  Be recognized by teammates as someone who raises the bar and improves team productivity.     Within 6 Months    Own a healthy book of repeat customers who consistently come back to work with you.  Continuously exceed your quota and build a strong forward‑looking pipeline.  Identify and implement tools, methods, or sales processes that improve performance.  Be on track for increased responsibility and future promotion opportunities.     What We’re Looking For   3–5 years of recent, quota‑carrying sales experience (not historic).  Strong foundation in consultative sales (Account Executive–type experience preferred).  Proven ability to manage and nurture customer accounts and generate repeat business.  Experience selling products or solutions in high‑velocity, SMB, or service‑based environments.  Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1 minimum).  High energy, professional presence, and strong video communication skills.  Coachable, curious, resilient, and comfortable receiving direct feedback.  Interest in apparel, custom products, or manufacturing is a strong plus.  Experience collaborating with design teams; Adobe Illustrator knowledge is an advantage.  Highly organized with strong CRM discipline (HubSpot experience is a plus).  Self‑starter who thrives in a remote, fast‑moving startup environment.  Comfortable working US hours (PST and EST).  Remote‑ready setup: laptop/desktop with at least 8GB RAM, stable internet (10 Mbps+), and a quiet workspace for customer calls.    Note: This role is not suited for appointment setters, BDR‑only profiles, or candidates transitioning into sales from non‑sales backgrounds.  Why You’ll Love It Here   Fast‑growing company redefining custom manufacturing.  High‑quality inbound leads. NO heavy cold calling.  Clear metrics, dashboards, and performance transparency.  Real growth opportunities for top performers.  Competitive compensation with uncapped commissions.  Personalized sales training to support both your role and long‑term career growth.  No micromanagement: we trust experienced sellers to own their work.       On‑target earnings (OTE): $2,200+ per month (base + uncapped commissions)   Additional Attributes & Process   Intellectually curious  – possesses a natural disposition and comfort to ask questions, challenge the status quo, and a desire to ‘get to the bottom of things’ if they see something not quite right  Self‑motivated  with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence  Good communication skills  that enhance collaboration, minimize misunderstandings, and at a frequency that is appropriate for a remote team  Radical candor  – coachable, accepting of constructive negative feedback and willing to provide constructive negative feedback where applicable  Operates with a level of urgency  – values immediate action where prudent, enables quick decision‑making, swift problem‑solving, and seizing opportunities in a dynamic business environment  Natural customer centricity  – has an affinity to always start their train of thought or analysis with the customer’s perspective, bias toward talking to the customer to understand them  Results‑driven  – focuses on achieving and exceeding measurable objectives  Submit an application. IMPORTANT: Please submit your resume/CV in English  Video Question  Written Assessment and Mock Call  CEO Interview  Reference Check    Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Regardless of the result, we always inform candidates via email.  Equal Opportunity Statement  At THE/STUDIO, we know that our Company’s strength lies in the diversity of our team. THE/STUDIO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Our policy is to provide equal opportunities for all applicants and individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We prioritize and maintain a fair, inclusive and equitable workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.  ***No third‑party recruiters/agencies please  Seniority level  Associate  Employment type  Full‑time  Job function  Sales and Customer Service  Industries  Internet Marketplace Platforms, Design Services, and Marketing Services  Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at THE/STUDIO by 2x   #J-18808-Ljbffr

You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.  Responsibilities   Centralize YouTube’s business generation strategy in Brazil, acting as the bridge between local sales and global teams.  Build a platform outlook based on user behavior, arming sales with data-driven narratives that connect consumption patterns to brand buying strategies.  Co-lead the annual plan, prioritizing and communicating Brazil’s business requirements to global product and engineering stakeholders.  Analyze data and market trends to identify opportunities, developing strategies to reach business goals.    Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Supply Chain Analyst - Capacity Planning
description:

About Latitude.sh  Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world.  We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single‑tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.  Summary  The Supply Chain Analyst will play a key role in developing and managing Latitude.sh’s capacity planning and vendor analysis framework across global data center operations — including space, power, network, and servers. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, and Finance teams, the analyst will anticipate capacity requirements, evaluate vendor proposals, and deliver clear reporting that guides infrastructure and procurement strategy.  Key Responsibilities   Capacity Planning & Forecasting  Develop and maintain comprehensive capacity planning models for data center space, power, servers, and network resources such as IP transit and backbone connectivity.  Forecast utilization to identify where capacity constraints may occur across the global portfolio.  Track provisioned versus active usage and provide early visibility into expansion needs.  Maintain dashboards showing available capacity, forecasted growth, and expected exhaustion timelines by site and service type.  Vendor Evaluation & Cost Analysis  Analyze and compare vendor proposals and quotes for data center colocation, IP transit, backbone, and related network services.  Build standardized cost‑comparison models to identify the most cost‑efficient vendor options.  Support procurement decisions with clear, data‑driven recommendations and total cost analyses.  Monitor vendor pricing, terms, and performance to ensure competitiveness and long‑term value.  Operational Reporting & Insights  Develop and manage a monthly reporting package or dashboard showing month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year variances in data center and network costs, and aggregate breakdowns by region, vendor, and service category.  Compare committed capacity versus billed actuals to identify underutilized or overextended resources and ensure full use of contracted commitments.  Validate and reconcile data across Finance and Operations to ensure reporting accuracy.  Present insights and recommendations that inform vendor selection, cost optimization, and capacity planning across teams.    Skills And Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).  2+ years of experience in supply chain analysis, capacity planning, cost management, or financial analysis, ideally within technology, telecommunications, or data center environments.  Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling).  Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.  Fluent in Portuguese, with professional‑level English (written and spoken).  Background in data center operations, network procurement, or telecom cost modeling (IP transit, dark fiber, backbone).    Preferred   Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and SQL or other data tools.  Exposure to DCIM, NetBox, or other infrastructure inventory systems.  Highly analytical and detail‑oriented, with strong quantitative reasoning.  Organized and methodical, capable of structuring complex datasets into clear insights.  Proactive and forward‑looking, anticipating capacity and cost challenges.  Excellent communication and presentation skills, effective with both technical and business audiences.  Collaborative and dependable, thriving in a dynamic, global environment.    What do we offer?   Competitive Compensation  Annual Bonus based on company and team performance  Meal voucher (Caju): R$805,22/monthly  Wellhub  Transportation or fuel voucher (without discounts)  Health Plan (Sulamérica)  Dental Plan (Amil)  Subsidies for education, certification and English courses  On‑site at Vila Mariana - São Paulo - SP    Why Latitude.sh?  We're a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem‑solving. As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.  Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We're proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality or disability. If these values speak to you, we'd love for you to become a part of our team.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Regional Automation Engineer, Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME
description:
Empresa está contratando Regional Automation Engineer, Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME em cajamar. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Overview DESCRIPTION: Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep. Amazon has several Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers and Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time. Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world. Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.  Purpose Of The Job We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as an Automation Engineer (AE). The focus of the AE role is to fault find, troubleshoot and improve controls solutions for automated material handling equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, scales, Human-Machine Interface (HMI) systems, and control cabinets. The AE will also provide training to the Engineering Technicians on device troubleshooting and preventive maintenance.  Responsibilities Be the site level Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all controls systems and sensors within the building. Work in a hands-on manner to actively monitor, fault find and repair systems in order to provide a high level of equipment availability to internal customers. Train technicians in the basics of control systems fault finding in order to raise the level of knowledge within the site. Work within the Global Controls network to enhance the capability to monitor Material Handling Equipment (MHE) metrics and provide visualization and data to internal customers by means of troubleshooting and prioritizing. Actively participate in or own continuous improvement projects coordinated by the Global Controls network. Work with Global Controls Engineering and Operations Engineering to ensure all systems are correctly documented and that accurate backup libraries are maintained. Work alongside global teams to support the installation and commission of new equipment. Support other sites in the Brazil network as required. Interpreting both mechanical and electrical drawings and understanding and developing improvement strategies for code conforming.   Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree; Experience with PLC controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment; Experience in dealing with material handling, flow and capacity; Experience in written and spoken English; Experience supporting a wide range of different conveyors and sortation systems; Experience with Microsoft Office, SolidWorks, Ignition, Visio and AutoCAD.   Preferred Qualifications Experience in a multi-site environment; Experience in project management; Knowledge of process improvement, ideally including Lean, Kaizen and Six Sigma; Electrical or mechanical training degree in computer science, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or related fields; Understanding of ISO 13849 & 62061.   Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit  for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  Company  - Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda. Job ID: A    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Analisar especificações técnicas e desenhos de engenharia para validar a conformidade de itens com os requisitos de segurança e qualidade. Implementar iniciativas de redução de custos e otimização de processos de suprimentos, sem comprometer a integridade operacional.  Gerenciar os níveis de estoque de peças críticas, prevenindo situações de ruptura (AOG – Aircraft on Ground) e otimizando o capital.  Assegurar a conformidade de todos os processos com as regulamentações aeronáuticas vigentes e com os procedimentos internos de qualidade e segurança.  Dominar o uso de sistemas de gestão (ERP, SAP) e plataformas especializadas do setor (ex.: ILS, AeroXchange) para cadastro, rastreamento e aquisição de peças.  Atuar como ponto de contato técnico-comercial para resolver problemas de qualidade, atrasos ou não-conformidades com fornecedores.    Requisitos Obrigatórios   Formação:  Bacharelado em Engenharia (Aeronáutica, Mecânica, Produção, Materiais ou áreas correlatas).  Experiência Comprovada  em funções de compras, suprimentos ou supply chain no setor de transporte aéreo, aviação ou aeroespacial .  Conhecimento sólido das normas regulatórias da aviação civil (ANAC, FAA, EASA).  Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de documentação técnica (manuais, catálogos de peças, desenhos) em inglês .  Habilidade avançada em ferramentas de gestão e análise: ERP (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS) e Excel (funções complexas, dashboards).  Competências sólidas em negociação estratégica, análise de custos e gestão de contratos.  Perfil proativo, analítico e com orientação rigorosa para detalhes, essencial em um ambiente de alta criticidade.    Diferenciais (Desejáveis)   Pós-graduação ou certificações em Compras, Supply Chain Management ou Gestão de Projetos.  Experiência com processos de importação/exportação de peças aeronáuticas e trâmites aduaneiros.  Conhecimento em sistemas de catálogos de peças aeronáuticas (PartsBase, Inventory Locator Service).  Vivência em processos de homologação e auditoria de fornecedores no setor aeroespacial.  Inglês fluente para comunicação comercial e técnica com fornecedores internacionais.    Competências Comportamentais   Pensamento Crítico e Resolução de Problemas:  capacidade de tomar decisões ágeis e precisas sob pressão.  Comunicação Efetiva:  habilidade para dialogar com diferentes áreas (técnicas e comerciais) e níveis hierárquicos.  Ética e Integridade Inegociáveis , aderente à cultura de segurança e compliance da aviação.  Organização e Orientação a Prazos:  disciplina para gerenciar múltiplas demandas críticas simultaneamente.  Trabalho em Equipe:  espírito colaborativo para atuar em um ambiente multidisciplinar e dinâmico.  Plano de saúde e odontológico extensivo à família;  Vale-refeição e/ou vale-alimentação;  Seguro de vida;  Previdência privada;  Auxílio home office ou auxílio-transporte (conforme modelo);  Programa de bonificação por resultados;  Possibilidade de participação em treinamentos e certificações do setor;  Ambiente de inovação com suporte de especialistas como Claire Joster.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Full Stack Developer for Cloud based Applications  Join to apply for the Full Stack Developer for Cloud based Applications  role at TK Elevator   Are you ready to shape the future of vertical transportation by building the digital solutions that power innovation? At TK Elevator, a globally leading elevator and escalator company, we're revolutionizing how people experience buildings through digital solutions that integrate elevator systems, embedded technology, cloud platforms, and AI-powered experiences.  Responsibilities  As full stack Application Developer, you'll bring a hands‑on, pragmatic get‑things‑done attitude to designing, developing, and maintaining digital service applications that bridge the physical and digital worlds. You'll roll up your sleeves to work closely with cross‑functional teams—UX/UI designers, product owners, and fellow developers—to deliver scalable, secure, and user‑friendly solutions that make our customers successful and transform service efficiency for 20,000+ technicians worldwide.   Application Development & Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain modern web and mobile applications using frameworks like Angular, .NET, and MAUI. Build cloud‑native solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with microservices, event‑driven architectures, and API‑first design principles.  Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Work closely with UX/UI designers, product owners, architects, and other development teams to translate business requirements into elegant technical solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions and share knowledge across the global team.  Code Excellence & Best Practices: Write clean, maintainable, and well‑documented code that others can understand and build upon. Participate actively in code reviews, champion best practices, and continuously improve code quality and development standards.  DevOps & Quality Integration: Develop automated tests and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable and efficient deployment. Support continuous integration and delivery practices that enable rapid, safe releases to production.  Performance & Reliability: Troubleshoot issues proactively, optimise application performance, and provide ongoing support for existing applications. Monitor system health and respond to incidents when needed to ensure high availability.  Security‑First Mindset: Integrate cybersecurity best practices into all phases of the development lifecycle. Implement secure authentication/authorization, protect sensitive data, and stay current with security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.    Qualifications   Development Experience & Expertise: 5+ years of hands‑on experience in application development with a proven track record building cloud‑native applications. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and C# with deep experience in modern frameworks including Angular, .NET, and MAUI.  Cloud & Architecture Proficiency: Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure, and solid understanding of microservices architectures, event‑driven systems, and API‑first design. Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and asynchronous messaging systems (Kafka, MQTT).  DevOps & Modern Development Practices: Strong understanding of DevOps practices and tools including Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana and OpenTelemetry. Experience with infrastructure as code and containerisation is a plus.  Security & Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of secure software design principles, authentication/authorization mechanisms (OAuth2, OpenID Connect), and data protection requirements. Experience implementing security best practices in application development.  Agile & Team Collaboration: Proven experience working in agile, cross‑functional product teams with ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and time zones. Comfortable in a fast‑paced, iterative development environment.  Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.    Personal Attributes   Problem‑solver: Strong analytical skills with ability to break down complex requirements into elegant solutions.  Pragmatic & hands‑on: Strongly driven, get‑things‑done attitude—ready to roll up your sleeves and go the extra mile to make products successful.  Team player & independent: Collaborative team member who can also take ownership and work independently when needed.  Clear communicator: Good communication skills in English, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.  Quality‑focused: Takes pride in writing clean code and building solutions that users love.    Benefits  Health care, Dental care, Bonus, Private pension, Program for pregnant women, Social support program, Life insurance, Telemedicine, Telenutrition, Telepsychology, Restaurant, Transportation. In close partnership with Fraud, Risk, Product, Compliance, and global operations teams, you will translate regulatory expectations, data, and intelligence into scalable, intelligence‑led solutions that strengthen the end‑to‑end merchant risk lifecycle. Oversee complex AML and sanctions investigations end‑to‑end, including transaction analysis, customer due diligence, adverse media review, escalation handling, and SAR recommendations across acquiring, issuing, banking, and capital products.  Monitor emerging AML, sanctions, and FinCrime typologies and regulatory developments, translating insights into improved controls, risk coverage, and operational readiness.  Implement and continuously enhance AML & Screening policies, procedures, and controls across transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting, aligned with Fraud and broader FinCrime strategy.  Drive operational excellence using data insights, automation, quality assurance, and root‑cause analysis, while partnering cross‑functionally to deliver scalable monitoring and detection capabilities. Who you are   6+ years of experience in AML, Screening, or broader Financial Crime within a financial institution, PSP, issuing bank, or fintech, including demonstrated people‑leadership skills.  Proven leader with a track record of building, mentoring, and motivating high‑performing teams, driving accountability, development, and a strong performance culture.  Strong analytical and problem‑solving capability, able to interpret complex data, identify risk trends, and make sound, risk‑based decisions in a KPI‑driven environment.  Experienced in designing scalable processes, controls, and operational improvements, while managing investigations and screening activities with precision and attention to detail.  Effective communicator and collaborative partner, comfortable operating in fast‑moving global environments, presenting to senior stakeholders, and adapting to evolving priorities; payments or FinTech experience preferred and willingness to travel internationally as required.  Payments, banking, or FinTech experience is strongly preferred.  Full professional proficiency in English with clear written and verbal communication skills; able to present insights to senior stakeholders.  Willingness to travel internationally as required. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.  Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!  What’s next?  Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.  This role is based out of our Sao Paulo  office. A Nextar atua desde 2003 criando soluções que transformem o comércio em uma atividade simples, justa e economicamente viável. Acreditamos nas pessoas e no empreendedorismo e nos dedicamos todos os dias para sermos facilitadores da rotina do pequeno comércio. Por isso, trabalhamos para desenvolver e entregar produtos e serviços de qualidade para mais de 50 mil pequenos comércios no Brasil e no mundo!  O que buscamos nas pessoas para compor nossa equipe?   Comprometimento e prazer em trabalhar colaborativamente —  que busque facilitar a vida das pessoas, tanto colegas, quanto clientes e empenhe-se em manter o ambiente amigável.  Atenção à comunicação escrita e oral —  que seja empática, assertiva e que agregue uma escuta verdadeira. Respeito às diferenças —  temos a diversidade e a inclusão como valor cultural e prezamos por manter nosso time diverso, agregando o valor de paradigmas únicos para expandir nossa qualidade e alcance. Temos muito a aprender ainda e temos também muita vontade de ampliarmos a nossa consciência cada dia mais.  Honestidade intelectual —  tenha proatividade em busca de conhecimento, generosidade em compartilhar o seu saber e abertura, humildade e respeito para orientar e receber orientações.  E identifique-se com gestão orgânica —  a serviço das pessoas e para as pessoas.  Oferecemos:    Remuneração competitiva com o mercado - prezamos pela transparência e por isso, ao abrir a vaga certa para você e entrarmos em contato, e já informaremos a faixa salarial disponível para a posição. Vale-Refeição/Alimentação no valor de R$ 800,00.  Auxílio Home Office — no valor de R$150,00.  Trabalho em Home Office integral, com possibilidade de híbrido na sede em Florianópolis à escolha da pessoa colaboradora.  Folga no seu aniversário e de seus filhos e/ou filhas.  Licença parental estendida e remunerada, que inclui a adoção e todas as identidades de gênero e núcleos familiares.  Sem código de vestimenta, tanto no online quanto no híbrido.  Bonificação trimestral a partir de resultados.  Cultura de Feedback.  Convênio SESC. - Desconto em serviços nas áreas de cultura, esporte, lazer, educação, saúde e assistência social.    Benefícios (Após 3 meses):    Plano de Saúde Unimed ou Bradesco — para sua saúde e de seus filhos e/ou filhas, sem desconto de coparticipação.  Plano Odontológico Uniodonto — para sua saúde bucal e de seus filhos e/ou filhas. Parceria com OnHappy - descontos em hotéis, passagens aéreas e ofertas exclusivas.  Parceria com a Open English - descontos em aulas de idiomas. Bora fazer parte?   Ao se inscrever, você declara que as informações fornecidas são verdadeiras e concorda em compartilhar seus dados com a Nextar, em conformidade com a LGPD.  Por aqui já somos mais de 150 pessoas engajadas a transformar as mais de 50 mil lojas pelo mundo! Se identificou com a gente? Se sim, nós também nos interessamos em conhecer mais sobre você! Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar mais mulheres e negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.  A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.  Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características. You can watch a winning VSL and break down exactly why it works. You read ad comments sections for fun. You've written scripts that stopped thumbs, moved product, and hit CPA targets, and you can prove it.  If that sounds like you, keep reading.  About Purolabs  Purolabs is an independent, family-run DTC supplements brand based in South London. We have served over 350,000 customers with clean, science-backed supplements. No fillers, no additives, no nonsense. Featured in Vogue, Women’s Health, and Evening Standard, we are a profitable, fast-growing brand proving that natural wellness can be both effective and transparent.  No shareholders to impress. No cutting corners. Just a genuine mission to help people feel better.  The Role  Creative strategy is our biggest growth lever. We are hiring a Creative Strategist to own the full creative system for our paid advertising, from research and ideation through to briefing, production, and performance analysis. You will develop ad concepts, write scripts and copy, create briefs, and work with editors and creators to produce ads that convert at scale.  This is a performance role. Data guides everything. You will live inside our ad accounts, study what’s working, and use those insights to develop the next round of winning creatives. Creative instinct matters, but the numbers have the final say.  Beyond individual ad creation, you will build and refine the system itself: creative roadmaps, testing cadence, playbooks, feedback loops, and production workflows. The goal is a repeatable engine, not a series of one-offs.  Your primary focus is Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Experience with TikTok or YouTube advertising is a bonus.  What You’ll Do  Research & Insight   Mine customer reviews, surveys, forums, and ad comments to understand the language, pain points, and motivations of our audience  Monitor competitor ads, offers, angles, and landing pages across the DTC landscape  Turn research into clear hypotheses and test plans grounded in consumer psychology    Creative Development   Develop ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts for video ads, VSLs, and UGC content  Write direct-response copy for static ads, carousels, and advertorials  Create detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators  Own landing page strategy and messaging for paid campaigns, working with the team to build high-converting pages  Build and maintain a library of proven hooks, frameworks, and winning ad structures    Performance & Iteration   Analyse ad account data to identify winning patterns, fatiguing creatives, and new opportunities  Iterate on winning ads at scale, producing variations of hooks, body copy, CTAs, and visual treatments  Run a tight feedback loop: learn from data, iterate on what works, kill what doesn’t  Present weekly creative performance reports with clear recommendations for what to test next    Process & Production   Maintain a strong creative cadence: roadmap, launch schedule, timelines, and quality control  Manage creative production flow, approvals, and external vendors  Build and refine playbooks, workflows, and processes to improve creative output over time  Collaborate with our Performance Marketing Manager, designers, video editors, and UGC creators    What We’re Looking For  Essential   3+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce (brand-side, agency, or freelance)  Proven track record writing ad scripts, VSL scripts, and static ad copy that delivered measurable results  Strong understanding of direct-response copywriting principles (AIDA, PAS, and similar frameworks)  Deep knowledge of Meta Ads platform and experience working in high-volume creative testing environments  Experience creating detailed creative briefs and managing creative production workflows  Strong understanding of consumer psychology, buyer motivation, and what makes people click  Ability to analyse ad performance data and translate insights into actionable creative direction  Experience using AI tools like Claude and Gemini  Excellent written English, clear and persuasive    Nice to Have   Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty DTC brands  TikTok or YouTube advertising experience  Experience casting and managing UGC creators  Familiarity with tools like Foreplay, Motion, Triple Whale, or Meta Ad Library  Landing page copywriting or CRO experience  Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)  Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for static ad concepts    You’ll Thrive Here If You Are   Data-obsessed.  You make creative decisions based on evidence, not gut feeling. You would rather test than argue.  Commercially minded.  You care about ROAS and CPA, not just aesthetics. A beautiful ad that does not convert is a failed ad.  Fast-moving.  You can produce and iterate at pace without sacrificing quality. Speed and volume matter in creative testing.  Proactive.  You do not wait to be told what to test next. You bring ideas to the table constantly.  Detail-oriented.  Your briefs are clear. Your scripts are tight. You spot what others miss.  A student of the game.  You are constantly saving ads, studying hooks, and analysing what’s working across DTC.    What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)   Creative strategy is fully owned and running as a consistent, repeatable system  You have deep customer understanding and clear positioning across the funnel  You have made measurable impact on ad performance through stronger creative strategy and faster iteration  Creative roadmap, playbooks, and production workflows are documented and running smoothly    What We Offer   Fully remote, work from anywhere with at least 4 hours daily overlap with UK timezone  Competitive rate based on experience  Paid time off including UK bank holidays  Creative freedom to test bold ideas and own your work from concept to results  Direct collaboration with founders, no layers of management  A small, dedicated team that values transparency, results, and doing things the right way  Products that genuinely help people feel better    How to Apply  Your application must include:   Your CV  in English  A portfolio of ad creative work.  Show us ads you have written or developed, with context on the results they drove. This can be a PDF, website, Google Drive link, or Notion page. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.  A short Vocaroo recording (2-3 minutes)  introducing yourself, what you have worked on, and why this role interests you. Applications without a Vocaroo will not be considered.    This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. Applications are welcome globally.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: HSS and Signalling Engineer - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based
description:
Nova oportunidade para HSS and Signalling Engineer - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Us  1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.  We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.  1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million  and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.  Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan KoçandPyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries  is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.  About the Team  As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analysing and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems, related with the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.  About the Role   Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions  Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery  Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions  Creation of technical documentation (HLD’s, LLD’s, WO’s, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions  Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements  Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators  Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition  Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems  Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies  Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers  Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities  Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle  Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes  Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives.    About You  Must-haves   Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture  Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications  Experience in the design, test and operation of signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS  Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects, SIGTRAN and DIAMETER based, using SCTP multi-homing  Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and respective reference interfaces  Knowledge of IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes, including Application Servers and its interaction with profile repositories  Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces  Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as we well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx  Knowledge of 5G SA networks, from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective  Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols  Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions  Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape  English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus  Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience    Nice-to-haves   +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks  Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, HPE products    What We Offer?   CLT contract  —enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work  Quarterly performance bonuses  to reward your hard work and achievements  Meal allowance paid into Caju card —R$100per working day  Health insurance with SulAmérica  —50% covered by the company  Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.  Daycare allowance  provided to mothers with children under 3 years old —R$500 per month per child  Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices  (Lisbon or Berlin)!    Why 1GLOBAL?   Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.  Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.  Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.  Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.  Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.  International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.  Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.  Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.    1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Account Manager Pleno e Sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Account Manager Pleno e Sênior em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

O Account Manager  integra o time de vendas da Blip, sendo responsável pela expansão e aumento do commit dos contratos da base. Nesse papel somos responsáveis por entender melhor o modelo de negócio, estratégias, objetivos e resultados a serem alcançados com o contato inteligente para propormos evoluções rápidas e consistentes aos nossos clientes.  Buscamos uma pessoa para liderar a gestão estratégica de uma carteira entre 50 e 90 clientes de alto potencial, com foco principal em expansão de receita recorrente.  Esperamos um perfil com mentalidade hunter dentro da base, capaz de identificar oportunidades de crescimento, construir relacionamentos executivos sólidos e conduzir ciclos completos de venda consultiva e complexa.  O objetivo é gerar crescimento acelerado de receita, previsibilidade de pipeline e forte proximidade com os clientes.  No papel de Account Manager, você precisa ter escuta ativa, fazer boas perguntas, ser intencional e relacional com os clientes, perspicaz na gestão de tempo e rotina, ter uma visão analítica dos dados para buscar padrões e trabalhar bem em equipe.  RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES   Prospecção ativa de oportunidades comerciais nas contas da carteira, através de contatos existentes ou novos;  Planejamento estratégico para as contas atendidas, priorizando as contas por potencial de crescimento e considerando potenciais áreas, frentes e os resultados esperados;  Fazer análise e mapeamento de oportunidades na carteira;  Criar e conduzir estratégias que cubram todo o ciclo de vendas dentro da base, desde o de mapeamento, prospecção, discovery, design de solução, negociação e fechamento;  Gerir expansão, fidelização e renovações contratuais;  Fazer a gestão da garantia de receita com os clientes da carteira;  Ser o principal canal de comunicação entre Blip e Clientes para assuntos comerciais e estratégicos;  Construir relacionamento e influência multi-thread (gestores, decisores e C-level);  Atuar como parceiro estratégico de negócio (trusted advisor);  Realizar a gestão do seu trabalho, dando visibilidade a todo o time de vendas, através de ferramentas estabelecidas (Hubspot);  Liderar gestão de eventuais crises com os clientes da carteira, e resolver problemas com criatividade e foco em resultados;  Ser proativo em relação a melhorias de processos internos;  Acompanhar métricas da carteira e forecast de receita;  Garantir acurácia de pipeline e previsões;  Operar com metas agressivas de crescimento e accountability sobre resultados.    REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES   Formação Superior Completa;  Experiência em Vendas B2B;  Experiência em gestão de contas (Enterprise, preferencialmente);  Habilidades para análise e manipulação de dados no Sheets/Excel;  Visão analítica relacionada aos processos, acompanhando métricas;  Segurança para se comunicar em Inglês e/ou Espanhol;  Residência em São Paulo;  Disponibilidade para viagens;  Ampla visão de negócios.    Será um diferencial se você tiver:   Experiência/Conhecimento em Vendas SaaS/Produtos de tecnologia;  Experiência com CRM (Hubspot, PipeDrive, Salesforce);  Experiência em outro BSP.    Vantagens e benefícios  Sua Experiência no Dia a Dia     Horário Flexível : Mais autonomia para organizar sua rotina com equilíbrio e responsabilidade.    Modelos de Trabalho Flexíveis : Remoto, híbrido ou presencial, conforme a necessidade da função.    No Dress Code : Liberdade para ser quem você é, sem formalidades.   ️ Auxílio Home Office e Blip Setup : Suporte financeiro para montar (ou melhorar) seu espaço de trabalho remoto.    Day Off de Aniversário : Um dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário para comemorar como quiser.    Blip Recharge:  São 5 dias de folga remunerados por ano, para cargos que não fazem registro de ponto, pensados para equilibrar a jornada.    Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida    ️ Vale Alimentação ou Refeição : R$ 1144,00 mensais, sem desconto e creditado inclusive nas férias e licenças.

A Nextar atua desde 2003 criando soluções que transformam o comércio em uma atividade simples, justa e economicamente viável. Acreditamos nas pessoas e no empreendedorismo e nos dedicamos todos os dias para sermos facilitadores da rotina do pequeno comércio. Flexibilidade e Adaptabilidade — mantemos a mente curiosa, aberta a ideias e buscamos sempre evolução, buscando melhores soluções.  Respeito às diferenças — valorizamos diversidade e inclusão como valor cultural.  Honestidade intelectual — proatividade em busca de conhecimento, generosidade em compartilhar o saber e abertura, humildade e respeito ao orientar e receber orientações. Cultura de feedback.  Convênio SESC – descontos em cultura, esporte, lazer, educação, saúde e assistência social. No Programa de Aprendiz JDE Peet’s, você tem a chance de fazer parte de marcas que levam uma xícara de momentos incríveis a milhões de pessoas. Trabalhar na maior empresa especializada em cafés e chás do mundo significa ter grandes ambições, e grandes ambições implicam em grandes responsabilidades. O mundo do café está em constante transformação, e aqui, na JDE Peet’s, queremos que você seja protagonista nessa jornada de evolução. Explore novas perspectivas. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.  Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento.  Nosso diferencial   Aqui na JDE Peet's, valorizamos o impacto dos nossos estagiários! Por isso, temos o programa Grão de Ouro – Safra Selecionada Estags , que reconhece e oferece uma premiação aos melhores projetos alinhados à nossa estratégia e competências de liderança. É a nossa forma de celebrar suas conquistas e potencializar seu crescimento!  #OrgulhodeSerJDEPeets #UmaXícaradeMomentosIncríveis  Descrição da empresa  Quem somos nós?   A JDE Peet’s é uma empresa líder mundial especializada em cafés e chás, sediada na Holanda e com uma história que começou em 1753. Despertamos possibilidades de café e chá em mais de 100 países com um portfólio de mais de 50 marcas, incluindo L’OR, Peet’s, Jacobs, Senseo, Tassimo, Douwe Egberts, OldTown, Super, Pickwick e Moccona.  No Brasil, somos a segunda maior empresa de café e temos atuação nacional com liderança absoluta em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro, conhecida através de suas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Caboclo, Damasco, Maratá e Café Pelé.  Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?   Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de chá e café. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar grande impacto.Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal.Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor uma xícara de café ou chá. Department:  Sales  Location:  LATAM-Brazil-Sao Paulo  Description  Junte-se a uma equipe que está mudando milhões de vidas  Transformando sorrisos. Transformando vidas. Transformando uma indústria.  Na Align Technology, acreditamos que um grande sorriso pode transformar a vida de uma pessoa. Por isso, criamos uma tecnologia que dá às pessoas a confiança para assumir o próximo passo. Nós revolucionamos a indústria ortodôntica com a introdução do sistema Invisalign, e nunca perdemos de vista esse espírito de inovação. Nossas equipes estão constantemente forçando os limites do que é possível.  Pronto para se juntar a nós?  Sobre essa oportunidade  O Gerente de Território é responsável pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de vendas de um determinado território, buscando proativamente avaliar as necessidades e o potencial de crescimento de uma base de clientes. Tem como objetivo garantir a execução do planejamento de vendas através de análise de segmentação e plano de visitas, dando assistência e criando estratégias para obtenção de resultados positivos em um ambiente desafiador e em crescimento acelerado. Usando todas as ferramentas e estratégias da Align Technology, você será fundamental na comunicação com os clientes.  Responsabilidades   Gerenciar uma geografia definida de contas focando em expandir os negócios e em identificar contas de alto potencial.  Usar ideias e uma abordagem consultiva de vendas para auxiliar aos clientes como inovar em seu setor e com seus clientes; desafie-os a modernizar e expandir seus negócios; ajudá-los na implementação da abordagem da odontologia digital, produtos e soluções da plataforma digital Align e refinar os processos e fluxos de trabalho.  Atingir metas trimestrais e anuais de vendas no território.  Criar, planejar e executar um plano de vendas em um território definido com base no entendimento do potencial de cada conta com foco em atingir o potencial máximo de cada cliente levando em consideração metas, desafios e oportunidades.  Planejar e executar a estratégia de vendas para determinar a visão prática, identificar lacunas e estabelecer soluções para impulsionar o crescimento conforme estratégias de vendas.  Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos positivos com todos os níveis de contas, incluindo funcionários, assistentes e doutores, demonstrando o foco da prática com base na integridade e confiança.  Compreender os recursos da conta para identificar lacunas e fornecer treinamento, recursos técnicos e suporte para garantir que eles estejam bem equipados para tratar pacientes com soluções de alinhamento apropriadas e garantir resultados positivos para os pacientes.  Exceder os objetivos de vendas e estabelecer a segmentação correta do cliente em seu território.  Realizar gestão de orçamento e inserir informações corretamente nos sistemas internos, bem como fazer boa utilização das ferramentas de trabalho da empresa, em conformidade com diretrizes e procedimentos internos.  Colaborar com outras equipes de vendas para aprender e garantir os melhores resultados para o território designado.  Outras atividades podem ser atribuídas ou revisadas conforme evolução e dinâmica dos negócios.    Para esta posição você precisa de…   Superior completo com mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas consultivas no mercado de dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de capital, digitais, financeiras ou pelo menos 3 anos de experiência relevante em negócios do segmento odontológico, ortodôntico ou comercial B2B relevantes.  Disposição e abertura para aprender de forma sólida o mercado de odontologia digital e forte interesse por tecnologias digitais.  Histórico de realizações de vendas competitivas bem-sucedidas, disposição para enfrentar desafios e trabalhar objeções.  Fortes habilidades de planejamento e organização do trabalho, experiente na criação de planos de ação e execução com maestria.  Excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita para guiar e orientar clientes de forma efetiva e gerenciar KOLs.  Habilidade e segurança para discutir negócios (ROI, margens, marketing) e explorar cenários para identificar perfil de clientes e propor as soluções mais adequadas ao momento.  Capacidade de gerenciar expectativas dos clientes e endereçar problemas de forma ágil e resolutiva.  Forte senso de colaboração e trabalho em equipe.  Flexibilidade, adaptabilidade e resiliência para atuar diante de mudanças nas dinâmicas dos negócios.  Carteira de habilitação válida e com disponibilidade para viagens/deslocamentos para reuniões a trabalho, quando necessário.    Educação   Curso superior completo em administração ou voltado a negócios.  Forte conhecimento prático do conjunto de produtos da Microsoft como Word, Excel, Power Point, sistemas de gestão como Salesforce, Concur, Protheus e iOS.  Inglês é desejável. Com mais de 400 anos de história o Grupo Sumitomo vem deixando marcas e legados e há 10 anos, chegou ao Brasil para somar forças da cultura japonesa com a cultura brasileira e prosperar ainda mais em seus negócios. Faça parte deste time você também! Um pouco mais sobre a Sumitomo Rubber do Brasil Inaugurada em outubro de 2013, a SRB segue os padrões mundiais de qualidade adotados pelo grupo Sumitomo Rubber Industries Ltda., que é pioneiro mundial em produção de pneus utilizando o que há de mais moderno em tecnologia. Aqui, a segurança tem prioridade em todas suas atividades, além disso, exerce um grande papel auxiliando no crescimento social e econômico da Fazenda Rio Grande, do estado do Paraná e do Brasil. É IMPORTANTE VOCÊ SABER   O contato com os candidatos inscritos se dará somente no surgimento de vaga, pois trata-se de BANCO DE TALENTOS.  A inscrição no Banco de Talentos visa a formação de um cadastro reserva para todo o Estado de São Paulo. Diferente dos demais processos seletivos, o objetivo principal do banco é reunir pessoas qualificadas para serem consideradas em futuras oportunidades.  Ao se cadastrar, é importante entender que esta é uma possibilidade para vagas que podem surgir a curto, médio ou longo prazo, por isso não temos previsão de quando haverá convocação.   A participação nas etapas do processo seletivo (como entrevistas, avaliações ou aulas-teste) poderá ocorrer de forma presencial ou online.   Caso alguma etapa seja realizada online, o acesso à internet e os equipamentos necessários são de responsabilidade da pessoa candidata. Relembramos também que eventuais falhas de conexão, de equipamentos ou a não visualização do e-mail de agendamento poderão impedir a realização e não haverá a possibilidade de reagendamento.   Toda comunicação será realizada exclusivamente por e-mail, por isso pedimos que você mantenha seus dados atualizados e verifique sua caixa de entrada, inclusive spam.   É permitida apenas uma inscrição por candidato(a). Se identificada, a qualquer momento, duplicidade de inscrição, caberá a exclusão do processo seletivo.   As datas das etapas podem ser agendadas com até 24h de antecedência.   Todos os inscritos no processo seletivo receberão o feedback positivo ou negativo, durante ou após o término do processo seletivo.   Caso haja alguma intercorrência, falha, necessidade de alteração nos dados de contato/currículo ou não recebimento da confirmação por e-mail no momento da inscrição, aconselhamos que o suporte da plataforma seja acionado.
